# PR #3662: Patch: follow-up to #3644 from the after-merge spot-check

Closes #3658

## What changed and why

A run kept on a device before #3644 held `{"type":"heal"}` in its `RunFile` log (the old campfire screen sent `{ type: "heal" }`). #3644 renamed `RunAction::Heal` to `GainMaxHp` with no serde alias, so that kept file no longer deserializes: `run_fold` throws, `foldKept` returns null, and `loadCore` silently drops the run without settling it — extractions are lost instead of banked with the R3496000 notice. Fixed by adding `#[serde(alias = "heal")]` to `GainMaxHp` in [crates/run/src/lib.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-3658/crates/run/src/lib.rs), plus one regression test `an_old_heal_rest_reads_as_gain_max_hp_and_folds` in [crates/run/src/tests.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-3658/crates/run/src/tests.rs) proving an old-shape kept file deserializes and folds to the identical end state. No spec or ruling change: this is a compatibility fix, and `RunEventOption.hp` intentionally keeps no alias (versioned content, not kept logs).

## Tests

- `cargo test -p jackioh-run an_old_heal_rest_reads_as_gain_max_hp_and_folds` — passed (1 passed).
- Alias removed temporarily — test FAILED as expected (unknown variant `heal`), then restored and passing.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-run` — 75 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-run --features ts ...` — passed, and `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` empty (alias is deserialization-only; codegen unchanged).
- `cargo fmt --check` — clean. `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings` — clean.

## Decisions

- Rejected the issue's store-reroute alternative (routing kept-file parse failures to `"gone"`): `foldKept`'s null path exists so a transient wasm failure never mints a history record, and settling parse throws as lost would bank a run as lost on a transient error. The alias fixes the root cause with no new branch.
- Deviated from the plan's test body in one spot: used `log.contains(&RunAction::GainMaxHp)` instead of `iter().any(...)` because clippy's deny-by-default `manual_contains` fires otherwise; semantics are identical.

Reviewer should look twice at the quoted `"gainMaxHp"` → `"heal"` replace in the test: the quotes confine it to action tags, and `play_out` rests at every campfire so the replaced file exercises the alias on a real kept log.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `muse`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

   fn an_old_heal_rest_reads_as_gain_max_hp_and_folds() {
       let content = content();
       let setup = setup(&content);
       let (end, log) = play_out(&content, &setup);

       );

       assert!(back.log.iter().any(|a| *a == RunAction::GainMaxHp));

  - `cargo test -p jackioh-run` (whole crate, no regressions)

- No web test file is touched, so no `pnpm --dir apps/web test` run is needed. No ruling is added or cited, so `cargo jackioh spec check` is not needed.

- [ ] `GainMaxHp` carries `#[serde(alias = "heal")]` and serializes as `gainMaxHp`
- [ ] The new test passes and fails with the alias removed (verify by stashing the one attribute, running the test, restoring)

## Risks

- Determinism/replay: the alias maps to the identical `GainMaxHp` variant, so an old rest folds exactly as today's rest; the test's `run_fold == Ok(end)` assertion guards this. No random pools or new branches are involved.
- Hidden information / client rules: untouched; the client still sends `gainMaxHp` and enforces nothing.

## Open questions

None. The issue settles the fix (alias) and its location; no person-only decision is needed.
